findings.description: Ryūen aims at Suzune's humiliation/coerced kneeling rather than simply optimizing class score; began kneeling but anonymous message interrupted plan
Kushida's direct sport roster leak admission, asserted VIP exchange and shifting expulsion target list separated from public Class A objective
Anonymous audio names Ibuki in the quoted collision instruction although direct observed collision concerns Kinoshita; do not silently correct, authenticate or collapse
Horikita retains Class A/brother objective but revises cooperative means; Sudō's one-sided romance and promises are not enduring guarantees
Ayanokōji accepts risk to have Suzune discover spy; cannot generalize to intentionally engineering Class D's entire loss
Last-place penalty is not elective written-test reward; a one-point test deduction is fallback only for student with insufficient 1000 private points.
Include Sudō's reported 82.4 kg grip measurement and retain Ayanokōji's 60.6 kg explicitly submaximal result.
Source supports Ryūen offering 500000 private points to Kinoshita, not proof of a completed payment; redact incorrect 'accepted payment' phrasing.
Previously omitted three Hirata-funded substitutions and separately self-funded Kushida/Ayanokōji substitution decisions; record as resource-limited strategy, not generic altruism.
Preserve exact 16-to-13 majority vote and abstentions, not generic class consensus.
Printed White-class losing-team deduction -100 conflicts with closing narrative class B -50. Retain source discrepancy, do not invent a school exception or overwrite narrated B net zero.

Restored source-specific coordinated pacing demonstration, Kōenji catch of Sudō blow, height-order tug formation, Ayanokōji last scavenger result and actual obstructed relay finish. All are event-bounded, not fixed global abilities.
